full_text_zh:
[P1] 爱国宝宝教育绘本
教育孩子热爱祖国
我爱你中国
何文楠／文 文栋／图
手机扫码
有声读物
煤炭工业出版社

[P2] 莹莹六岁了，暑假妈妈给她报了个国际夏令营，莹莹可高兴了。
“妈妈，这件衣服我要带去，这个小枕头我也要带去，你快帮我收拾呀！”莹莹指挥着妈妈。

[P3] “好，妈妈来给你收拾，我的小公主！”妈妈笑着说。看着妈妈把自己喜欢的小玩意都整理好了，莹莹高兴地蹦来蹦去。

到了夏令营，妈妈对莹莹说：“妈妈走了，你要和小朋友们好好玩哦。”“知道啦，妈妈你快走吧！”莹莹迫不及待地想去认识新朋友。

[P4] 妈妈走后，莹莹不停地跑来跑去。
看到蓝眼睛白皮肤的小朋友，她好奇；看到黑皮肤的非洲小朋友，她又目不转睛地看着人家。

[P5] 总之，莹莹像是来到了一个新世界。上课了，老师先给同学们介绍班级里的新同学：“同学们，我们将在这里进行为期一周的夏令营，老师很高兴地告诉你们：我们班有一位同学来自中国，一位同学来自美国，还有一位来自加拿大。”

[P6] “哇！”莹莹转过头去看周围的
同学，发现其他同学也像她
一样好奇地东张西望。

下课后，莹莹跑过去和同学们玩：
“你叫什么名字，我叫莹莹。”
“我叫阿奇。”
“我叫杰克。”
“我叫丽萨。”
……

[P7] “你们会讲中文啊？好棒啊！”莹莹惊呼。
“在中国之前，我们都学过简单的中文。”外国同学解释道。
“这是什么？”莹莹看着杰克带来的一只塑料小狗。
“这是我们美国制造的儿童宠物，可以在家长不在家的时候陪伴小朋友。”
“太好玩啦！”莹莹和宠物小狗玩得不亦乐乎。
“这个又是什么？”莹莹看着丽萨的手腕。
“这个是电话手表，晚上的时候会发光，还可以用来照明。”
“哇！可不可以借我玩？”莹莹问道。
“当然可以。”丽萨很大方。
“加拿大真的太棒了！能够设计出这么好玩的东西！我太爱加拿大了！”莹莹晚上用丽萨的手表来照明的时候不禁感叹道。

[P8] 第二天上课的时候，老师问：“同学们，你们最喜欢哪个国家啊？”
“我最喜欢美国和加拿大，因为它们能够设计出那么棒的玩具！”莹莹抢先回答。
“好，坐下。还有哪位同学要回答。”

[P9] 中国制造
“我最喜欢中国。因为我们从早上起床到晚上睡觉用到的东西都是中国制造的。” 杰克回答道。

[P10] “我最喜欢中国。因为我不能想象如果离开了中国，我们的生活会变成什么样。”丽萨回答道。

[P11] “我也是最喜欢中国，因为中国人民非常善良，一直在救济我们肯尼亚，如果没有中国，就没有非洲的今天！”阿奇说道。

[P12] 听着同学们的回答，莹莹陷入了沉思。原来自己国家那么伟大，世界各国人民都体会到中国的伟大，可自己却因为一个玩具便觉得中国不如其他国家，真是太不应该了。

晚上篝火晚会的时候，莹莹郑重地拿出自己做的五星红旗送给同学们：“五星红旗是我们中国国旗，送你们每人一面，希望你们会喜欢。”

[P13] “谢谢！”
“这是最好的礼物！”
“我爱你中国！”
同学们纷纷说道。
“我爱你中国！”莹莹也不禁大喊。
full_text_en:
[P1] Patriotic Baby Education Picture Book
Educating children to love their motherland
I Love You, China
He Wen Nan / Text, Wen Dong / Illustrations
Scan QR code with your phone
Audio book
China Coal Industry Publishing House

[P2] Yingying is six years old. During the summer vacation, her mom signed her up for an international summer camp, and Yingying was very excited.
"Mom, I want to take this dress, and I want to take this little pillow too. Please help me pack!" Yingying instructed her mom.

[P3] "Alright, Mommy will pack for you, my little princess!" Mom said with a smile. Seeing Mom pack all her favorite little things, Yingying jumped up and down with joy.

At the summer camp, Mom said to Yingying, "Mommy is leaving, you must have a good time with your friends." "Got it, Mommy, you can go now!" Yingying couldn't wait to meet her new friends.

[P4] After her mom left, Yingying kept running back and forth.
Seeing the children with blue eyes and white skin, she felt curious; seeing the African children with dark skin, she stared at them intently.

[P5] In short, Yingying felt as if she had entered a new world. Class began, and the teacher introduced the new students to the class: "Classmates, we will be having a one-week summer camp here. The teacher is very happy to tell you: we have one student from China, one from the United States, and one from Canada in our class."

[P6] "Wow!" Yingying turned her head to look at the classmates around her, and found that other students were also curiously looking around.

After class, Yingying ran over to play with her classmates:
"What's your name? I'm Yingying."
"I'm Aqi."
"I'm Jack."
"I'm Lisa."
……

[P7] "You can speak Chinese? That's amazing!" Yingying exclaimed.
"Before coming to China, we all learned some simple Chinese," the foreign classmates explained.
"What is this?" Yingying asked, looking at the plastic dog Jack brought.
"This is a children's pet made in the United States. It can accompany kids when parents are away from home."
"So much fun!" Yingying played happily with the toy dog.
"What's this one?" Yingying asked, looking at Lisa's wrist.
"This is a smartwatch. It glows at night and can also be used for lighting."
"Wow! Can I borrow it to play?" Yingying asked.
"Of course!" Lisa replied generously.
"Canada is truly amazing! To be able to design such a fun thing! I love Canada so much!" Yingying exclaimed as she used Lisa's watch for light at night.

[P8] The next day, during class, the teacher asked, "Class, which country do you like the most?"
"I like the United States and Canada the most, because they can design such amazing toys!" Yingying answered quickly.
"Good, sit down. Is there anyone else who wants to answer?"

[P9] Made in China
"I like China the most. Because everything we use from the moment we wake up in the morning until we go to sleep at night is made in China," Jack replied.

[P10] "I like China the most. Because I can't imagine what our lives would be like if we left China," Lisa replied.

[P11] "I also like China the most, because the Chinese people are very kind and have been helping us in Kenya. Without China, there would be no Africa today!" said Aqi.

[P12] Hearing her classmates' answers, Yingying fell into deep thought. She realized how great her own country was, and that people from all over the world could feel China's greatness. Yet, she had once thought China was not as good as other countries just because of a toy—how wrong that was!

During the evening bonfire party, Yingying solemnly took out the five-star red flags she had made and gave them to her classmates: "The five-star red flag is our national flag of China. I'm giving each of you one. I hope you'll like them."

[P13] "Thank you!"
"This is the best gift!"
"I love China!"
the classmates said one after another.
"I love China!" Yingying couldn't help shouting.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《我爱你中国》的封面，展示了三位手持小红旗的儿童在草地上，上方有书名、作者和出版社信息，左下角有二维码提示可扫码收听有声读物。
[P2] 六岁的莹莹即将参加国际夏令营，她兴奋地向妈妈展示要带的衣物和小枕头，并指挥妈妈帮忙收拾行李。
[P3] 妈妈为莹莹收拾行李，莹莹开心地蹦跳；到达夏令营后，妈妈叮嘱她好好玩，莹莹迫不及待地想认识新朋友。
[P4] 妈妈离开后，莹莹在营地兴奋地跑来跑去，对不同肤色和外貌的外国小朋友表现出好奇和专注的观察。
[P5] 莹莹在夏令营课堂上，老师向同学们介绍新同学，提到班上有来自中国、美国和加拿大的学生，莹莹仿佛置身于一个全新的世界。
[P6] 莹莹在夏令营下课后主动与外国同学打招呼，互相介绍名字，表现出友好和好奇，其他同学也像她一样好奇地张望。
[P7] 莹莹在夏令营中与外国同学互动，对他们的玩具和科技产品表现出浓厚兴趣，并借用了丽萨的电话手表，感叹加拿大的科技产品很厉害。
[P8] 在夏令营的第二天课堂上，老师提问同学们最喜欢的国家，莹莹抢先回答她最喜欢美国和加拿大，因为它们设计的玩具很棒，老师随后请其他同学回答。
[P9] 在夏令营课堂上，当老师提问最喜欢的国家时，外国学生杰克回答他最喜欢中国，因为日常用品多为中国制造，画面中晾晒的衣物上印有“中国制造”字样。
[P10] 丽萨在夏令营中表示她最喜欢中国，因为她无法想象离开中国后生活会变成什么样，画面中她与莹莹互动，背景有晾晒的衣物和电话手表等物品。
[P11] 在夏令营的露营场景中，来自肯尼亚的阿奇表示她最喜欢中国，因为中国人民善良并长期援助肯尼亚，她认为没有中国就没有非洲的今天。
[P12] 莹莹在听完同学们对中国的赞美后陷入沉思，意识到自己曾因一个玩具而轻视祖国是不对的。在篝火晚会上，她郑重地将自己制作的五星红旗送给外国同学，表达对祖国的热爱与分享。
[P13] 在篝火晚会的场景中，莹莹将自己制作的五星红旗送给外国同学，同学们纷纷表达对中国的喜爱，莹莹也激动地喊出对祖国的爱。
